"Hello, I am Avadin for seniors. Avadin can help you with various tasks using artificial intelligence. Not just an ordinary robot or AI speaker, but a secretary for seniors living alone. Avadin manages and reports necessary information to caregivers."

"Let me introduce five things Avadin can do."

"First, Dasom Talk — a community to find friends and enjoy conversations. Second, video calls and messaging — connect with family. Third, emergency alerts — notify family in case of sudden illness. Fourth, medication alarms — reminding medication time. Fifth, music and radio playback — Avadin also serves as TV and radio."

"Third, emergency alerts."
